title: Our tour guide was so...
text: Our tour guide was so passionate and knowledgeable.  We couldn’t have had a better experience.  We feel like we truly have a friend in Granada.
author: Raylene_R

title: Enjoyable and educational!
text: Had a terrific tour of the Cathedral and Royal Chapel with our tour guide, Juanjo, who is exceptional. His knowledge of Granada is impressive, and he shares the city’s history in an educational and interesting way. Juanjo is easily the best tour guide I’ve met in my travels!
author: Chris K
